subject: Endgame contingency: procurement hold and updated MAP proposal
messages:
From: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@medisys.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@medisys.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Endgame contingency: procurement hold and updated MAP proposal

Jonas —

Quick note from our side: procurement has flagged the SOC2 evidence gap (they want the controls summary and a limited log sample) and are holding signature until they see it. The legal/finance teams are also requesting a clearer acceptance window — they feared the go-live date drifting again.

We’re committed to moving forward with Redwood, but we need a tightened MAP and an explicit contingency if we miss the current 4/15 go-live. Is there a way to: (a) provide minimal evidence that satisfies procurement for gating, and (b) capture an explicit extension and discount if timeline slips beyond three weeks?

I can introduce you to their operations lead if that helps.

Thanks,
Lisa
Lisa Tran
VP, Platform Ops — Medisys Health

Attachments: none

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@medisys.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@medisys.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Endgame contingency: procurement hold and updated MAP proposal

Lisa — thank you for the heads up and the specifics. We can do both. Proposed immediate steps (quick MAP patch):

- Provide a "SOC2 minimum evidence pack" today with: control summary, retention policy excerpt, three sample audit log entries (masked), and our SOC2 point contact. (Marcus will lead delivery.)
- Lock an updated MAP with explicit milestones and an acceptance window. If we miss the agreed go-live by >21 days we will offer a one-time credit (TBD by finance) and a deferred invoicing option.
- Set a short escalation path: if procurement still blocks after evidence delivery, we escalate to Laura / Sales Ops for a decision within 48 hours.

Can you confirm procurement's preferred evidence format (PDF vs shared Drive) and whether Ops wants an on-call walkthrough next week? I will attach MAP_v2 (provisional) and SOC pack stub.

Thanks — I'll coordinate internally and send an internal risk log for exec review.

Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx (draft)

From: Procurement Team <procurement@medisys.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@medisys.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Endgame contingency: procurement hold and updated MAP proposal

Jonas / Lisa —

Thanks. To be crystal clear, procurement requires the following before legal will accept terms:

1) Controls summary (1–2 pages) describing data access controls and retention.
2) Proof of audit log retention policy + 3 sample entries (redacted).
3) Confirmation of encryption at rest/in transit and KMS approach.

PDF is preferred for attachments; we will accept a private Drive link if it has a short-lived token.

If Redwood can provide the above by EOD Wed 24 Mar, procurement can keep the current approval cadence. If not, the approval will enter a formal delayed review and we will require a revised MAP.

Procurement Team
Medisys Health

Attachments: evidence_request_template.docx (referenced)

From: marcus.lin@redwood.com <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: lisa.tran@medisys.com, procurement@medisys.com
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Endgame contingency: procurement hold and updated MAP proposal

> Jonas / Lisa —
> 
> Thanks. To be crystal clear, procurement requires the following before legal will accept terms:
> 
> 1) Controls summary (1–2 pages) describing data access controls and retention.
> 2) Proof of audit log retention policy + 3 sample entries (redacted).
> 3) Confirmation of encryption at rest/in transit and KMS approach.

All — I can assemble a minimal evidence pack that satisfies those asks by EOD Wed 24 Mar. Plan:

- Controls summary: one-page PDF we can ship today (status: draft).
- Log samples: extract three masked entries from our retention staging (status: ready, will redact).
- KMS note: include short blurb and a diagram of keyflow (1/2 page).

Risk note: delivering minimal evidence keeps procurement moving but does not substitute for a full SOC2 report; recommend we add a temporary contractual clause limiting data retention scope during the first 30 days of production.

I will attach the SOC2_minimum_evidence.pdf when complete.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_minimum_evidence.pdf (stub)

From: ben.carter@redwood.com <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: credit ask and escalation for Medisys D-2027-0442

Jonas / Laura —

I reviewed the risk log and the proposed contingency: if procurement pushes past 24 Mar, the probability of a >21 day slip rises significantly. To avoid losing momentum, recommend we pre-authorize a credit up to $50k (one-time, applied at first invoice) and a 21-day extension window. This keeps the commercial discussion simple for Medisys and gives them runway while we finalize evidence.

If leadership approves, I can mark the quote with a conditional credit and prepare a short exec escalation note. Otherwise we risk procurement asking for additional contract concessions.

Numbers: Estimated ARR impact negligible for this account profile vs. opportunity risk.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments: none

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Internal escalation: Medisys MAP patch, risk log, and approval request

Team —

TL;DR: procurement asked for SOC2-minimum evidence. Marcus will deliver the pack (done). Procurement will keep the current cadence if evidence arrives by 24 Mar, but it arrived at EOD and legal needs time. Medisys is asking for an explicit contingency if we slip. I recommend approving:

- 21-day extension (if go-live slips beyond 4/15)
- one-time credit up to $50k applied at invoice if extension triggers
- Azure-hosted Private instance with restricted data retention for first 30 days (temporary clause)

Attached: MAP_v3.xlsx (final draft), SOC2_minimum_evidence.pdf. Also included a DocuSign invite for the amended MPA (link below). Please reply with approvals or objections by EOD Tue 30 Mar — we need to give procurement a firm answer to avoid a formal delayed review.

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/442/D-2027-0442
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/1234-approve

Thanks,
Jonas

Attachments: MAP_v3.xlsx, SOC2_minimum_evidence.pdf, docsign_invite.url
